intent: Restore three power cells under timed conduit hazards, reactivate the central reactor, and extract by shuttle before emergency power expires.

nodes.name: Station World
nodes.description: Approved visual scene, native collision, anchors, interaction wrappers, and effects.

nodes.name: Power Recovery Loop
nodes.description: Server-authoritative countdown, cell carrying, deposits, hazards, scoring, extraction, failure, and replay.

nodes.name: Responsive Mission UI
nodes.description: Safe-area-aware menu, HUD, feedback, result, touch activation, keyboard, and gamepad input.

nodes.name: Runtime Interface Root
nodes.description: Direct native declaration for the bounded shared runtime container.

visualDirection.artDirection: A cold graphite station uses cyan reactor light as orientation, amber for actionable cells, red for conduit danger, and pale shuttle surfaces for extraction. The reactor dominates the center; distinct asymmetrical bays and layered hull silhouettes keep the 192 by 144 stud route readable. UI uses the same restrained dark, cyan, amber, red, and pale hierarchy with large safe-area-aware targets.

views.name: Opening View
views.setup: Capture the first playable frame before the countdown begins.
criteria: The central reactor is the primary landmark and the shuttle is a readable secondary destination.
The three bay silhouettes are distinct without obscuring the mission route.

views.name: Reactor and Shuttle Approach
views.setup: Capture the route as the player leaves the reactor for extraction.
criteria: The route remains clear and the shuttle reads as the next objective.
Static chunks meet without visible seams or blocked clearance.

views.name: Warning Interaction
views.setup: Capture a carried cell beside a conduit during its warning phase.
criteria: Danger red is distinct from the amber pickup and cyan objective roles.
The warning remains legible without covering the route or carried-cell feedback.

views.name: Power Restoration
views.setup: Capture the reactor after the third cell deposit and before extraction.
criteria: Restoration feedback changes the world-state hierarchy clearly.
The extraction direction remains readable from the reactor.

views.name: Phone UI
views.setup: Capture menu, active HUD, warning, and result states with touch input enabled.
criteria: The primary action remains at least 48 pixels and inside safe-area insets.
Timer, cells, integrity, score, and feedback remain readable without overlap.

views.name: Desktop UI
views.setup: Capture menu, active HUD, warning, and result states with keyboard or gamepad selection.
criteria: The hierarchy stays compact at desktop width and the world remains visible.
Keyboard and gamepad prompts match the available actions.

obligations.description: Creator approves the exact compiled GLBs and named renders for this scene revision.
Detached Studio inspection proves exact asset version, hierarchy, transforms, materials, pivots, and bounds.
Remote intents cannot write timers, integrity, deposits, hazards, score, extraction, or results.
Creator completes ten win, loss, and replay cycles in Studio after save and reopen.
Creator reviews the named phone and desktop UI views and their feedback states.
